slides.headline: YOUR WEBSITE IS LOSING CUSTOMERS RIGHT NOW, AND 6 AI PROMPTS FIX EVERY PAGE.
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up, intense focus, both hands pressing flat colorful website wireframe on workshop table with red marking pen, warm amber pendants overhead, clean walls, documentary film grain, amber gold against electric blue shadow.

slides.headline: 1) WRITE YOUR HOMEPAGE OPENER SO NOBODY LEAVES
slides.body: Prompt: "Act as a direct-response copywriter. Write a homepage opener for [YOUR BUSINESS]. My customer's biggest fear is [FEAR]. I solve it by [HOW]. Write 2, 3 sentences: open by naming the fear, close with the outcome. No welcome lines, no fluff." Swap the brackets and this produces the section copywriters charge $3,000 for.

slides.headline: 2) TURN YOUR STORY INTO A REASON THEY BUY
slides.body: Prompt: "Act as a brand storyteller. Write an about page for [YOUR NAME / BUSINESS]. My customer's problem: [PROBLEM]. My relevant background: [BACKGROUND]. Lead with their problem, show why my path makes me the right person to solve it, end with one sentence inviting them to hire me." This makes the customer the hero so hiring you feels like the obvious next step.

slides.headline: 3) WRITE A SERVICES PAGE THAT JUSTIFIES YOUR PRICE
slides.body: Prompt: "Act as a conversion copywriter. Write a services page section for [YOUR SERVICE]. Outcome the client gets: [OUTCOME]. Price: [PRICE]. Lead with the outcome, briefly name the process in one line, end with a sentence that makes the price feel obvious. No bullet lists of deliverables." This leads with what the client gets and buries the process so visitors know it's worth it.

slides.headline: 4) TURN RAW REVIEWS INTO A PAGE THAT SELLS
slides.body: Prompt: "Act as a social proof strategist. Here are my customer reviews: [PASTE REVIEWS]. Group them by the fear each one resolves. Label each group with that fear as a header. Place the most credible review first in each group." This turns five-star reviews sitting unorganized on Google into a testimonials section worth more than any discount on your pricing page.

slides.headline: 5) BUILD AN FAQ THAT CLOSES DEALS WHILE YOU SLEEP
slides.body: Prompt: "Act as a sales consultant. Here are the objections and questions I hear most before someone hires me: [LIST OBJECTIONS]. Turn each into an FAQ entry that answers the fear behind the question, not just the question itself. Keep each answer to 2, 3 sentences." This builds a FAQ from objections you already hear, not the ones you wish they had.

slides.headline: 6) WRITE A CALL-TO-ACTION THAT CONVERTS WITHOUT PUSHING
slides.body: Prompt: "Act as a conversion copywriter. Write a call-to-action section for my [SERVICE] page. What the visitor gets: [WHAT THEY GET]. Their last fear before clicking: [FEAR]. Commitment level: [FREE CALL / PRICE]. Name the outcome, remove the fear, and write a button label that describes the result not the click." This produces a CTA that names what the visitor gets and removes their last fear before they click.

caption:
Swipe to grab all 6 AI prompts that write your entire website tonight, the same work a copywriter charges $10,000 for. 💾

Homepage opener that makes visitors stay, about page that turns your story into a reason to buy, services page that justifies your price, testimonials section that turns raw reviews into a buying case, FAQ that closes deals while you sleep, call-to-action that converts without pushing.

Website copy is the one thing most business owners pay for twice: once to a copywriter who misses the point, once to fix it. These prompts write in the framework that converts. Every major section, done tonight.
